name: Reverse Engineering procs from periodic healing ticks (#1965)
contract: Reverse Engineering 520875 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) twice, on 1257670 (Replenishment) and 520936 (a haste buff), but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the caster's own periodic damage/healing ticks (15% chance per tick, no family restriction), a single Accelerated Recovery cast (a 1-second-tick heal-over-time) gives many independent per-tick trials, so at least one should land within its duration.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Reverse Engineering haste buff before any periodic tick
At least one periodic heal tick (15% chance each, roughly one per second) procs the haste buff
